verdict.rationale: Fellow documents non-interactive automation through its own REST Developer API. It uses static API keys in request headers and supports per-application keys, plus Super Admin keys that can act on behalf of any user. Scripts can upload recordings, poll processing status, read and write notes and action items, and receive webhooks, so a headless script or pipeline can drive the product. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI integration, or service-account guidance aimed at CI, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline usage or examples, published machine-readable API spec, independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
